turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting resistance welding electrode diagnostic and qualification procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Begin by completing the initial electrode inspection. Check the electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than one millimeter or any mushrooming. Examine the cap shank contact surfaces for corrosion or mechanical damage, and inspect the coolant ports on each electrode arm for blockage.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than 1 mm or mushrooming. 2. Check the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage. 3. Inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Initial inspection complete. The electrode caps show minor surface wear but no deep pitting or mushrooming. The shank surfaces are clean and the coolant ports are clear.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than 1 mm or mushrooming. 2. Check the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage. 3. Inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are there any signs of electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming, or cracking?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the caps are in serviceable condition with only light wear marks. No cracking or severe damage observed.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the electrode face diameter within the wear limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode face diameter within wear limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The face diameter is below the minimum serviceable dimension. It's worn beyond the acceptable limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode face diameter within wear limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Dress the electrode caps to nominal geometry using the electrode dresser.

ground_truth.node_text: Dress electrode caps to nominal geometry using electrode dresser

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Electrode caps dressed. Both faces are now restored to nominal geometry and the surface finish looks good.

ground_truth.node_text: Dress electrode caps to nominal geometry using electrode dresser

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: With the cooling circuit running, measure the cooling water flow rate at both electrodes. Place an inline flow meter at the cooling water outlet and record the flow rate in liters per minute. Compare the reading against the minimum cooling flow specification for this electrode size.

ground_truth.node_text: With the cooling circuit running, place an inline flow meter or a timed collection vessel at the cooling water outlet from the electrode holder body. Record the flow rate in litres per minute and compare against the minimum cooling flow for this electrode size in the resistance welding machine specification. Low flow indicates a partially blocked cooling channel or a failing recirculation pump.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm seeing the flow rate is within spec, but the electrode holder body is still running way hotter than it should be—feels like the heat isn't being carried away even though water's moving through fine.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Flow rate measured at both electrodes. Left side reads four point two liters per minute, right side reads four point one. Both values are above the minimum specification.

ground_truth.node_text: With the cooling circuit running, place an inline flow meter or a timed collection vessel at the cooling water outlet from the electrode holder body. Record the flow rate in litres per minute and compare against the minimum cooling flow for this electrode size in the resistance welding machine specification. Low flow indicates a partially blocked cooling channel or a failing recirculation pump.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

ground_truth.node_text: Cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The flow rate looks okay, but I'm getting a high temperature alarm on the secondary coolant heat exchanger that's not dropping even though flow is normal.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both electrodes are showing adequate flow rates well above the minimum threshold.

ground_truth.node_text: Cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the electrode force within plus or minus five percent of the programmed schedule value?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode force within ±5% of programmed schedule value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the load cell shows the force is within the tolerance band. Reading four hundred eighty newtons against a target of four hundred seventy five.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode force within ±5% of programmed schedule value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the measured weld current within plus or minus three percent of the scheduled value?

ground_truth.node_text: Measured weld current within ±3% of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Confirmed. The peak current measured at eight point seven kiloamps, which is within spec for the eight point five kiloamp schedule.

ground_truth.node_text: Measured weld current within ±3% of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the weld time within plus or minus one cycle of the scheduled value?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld time within ±1 cycle of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The timer is running long. I'm measuring eighteen cycles when the schedule calls for sixteen. That's outside the tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Weld time within ±1 cycle of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the weld timer setting in the controller schedule to bring it within tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust weld timer setting in controller schedule

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Timer adjustment made in the controller. The setting is now corrected to sixteen cycles.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust weld timer setting in controller schedule

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Clean both electrode faces and perform a contact pattern test. Place carbon transfer paper between the electrodes, close them at twenty-five percent of programmed force, then inspect the transfer pattern on each face for concentricity and coverage.

ground_truth.node_text: Clean both electrode faces and place a sheet of carbon transfer paper between them. Close the electrodes at 25% of the programmed force setting and open. Inspect the carbon transfer pattern on each face; the contact impression should be concentric and cover the full electrode face area uniformly. An off centre or crescent shaped pattern indicates electrode misalignment requiring mechanical correction.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Contact pattern test complete. The impression on both faces is off-center with only about seventy percent coverage. The pattern is crescent-shaped on the upper electrode.

ground_truth.node_text: Clean both electrode faces and place a sheet of carbon transfer paper between them. Close the electrodes at 25% of the programmed force setting and open. Inspect the carbon transfer pattern on each face; the contact impression should be concentric and cover the full electrode face area uniformly. An off centre or crescent shaped pattern indicates electrode misalignment requiring mechanical correction.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the electrode faces parallel with contact pattern above ninety percent of the face area?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode faces parallel, contact pattern above 90% of face area?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Hey, before I check that, do you know if the new safety harnesses came in yet? I was supposed to get trained on them this week.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the pattern coverage is below ninety percent and the crescent shape indicates misalignment.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode faces parallel, contact pattern above 90% of face area?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the electrode arm tilt to achieve parallel contact between the electrode faces.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust electrode arm tilt to achieve parallel contact

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Electrode arm tilt adjusted. The upper arm has been corrected and the alignment looks much better now.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust electrode arm tilt to achieve parallel contact

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Prepare five test specimens from the production material stack and weld each at nominal schedule settings. Label each specimen and measure the weld nugget diameter, recording the results in the pilot weld log.

ground_truth.node_text: Prepare five test specimens cut from the production material stack with the correct number of layers and thickness. Weld each specimen at the nominal schedule settings and label each with the weld number and machine setting used. Measure the weld nugget diameter visually or by ultrasonic means and record the result in the pilot weld log before proceeding to non destructive testing.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Five pilot welds completed and labeled. All specimens have been welded and the nugget diameters recorded in the log.

ground_truth.node_text: Prepare five test specimens cut from the production material stack with the correct number of layers and thickness. Weld each specimen at the nominal schedule settings and label each with the weld number and machine setting used. Measure the weld nugget diameter visually or by ultrasonic means and record the result in the pilot weld log before proceeding to non destructive testing.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Do the pilot welds show acceptable appearance with no spatter, expulsion, or surface cracks?

ground_truth.node_text: Pilot weld appearance, no spatter, expulsion or surface cracks?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The weld looks okay visually, but I'm seeing some discoloration and heat tinting around the weld zone that seems excessive for a normal pilot weld.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm seeing some minor spatter around the weld zone on three of the five specimens. The surface finish isn't quite right.

ground_truth.node_text: Pilot weld appearance, no spatter, expulsion or surface cracks?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the weld schedule by modifying the current and force parameters for this material batch.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust weld schedule, modify current and force for material batch

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Schedule adjusted. I've reduced the current slightly and increased the force to reduce spatter.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust weld schedule, modify current and force for material batch

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Perform ultrasonic inspection on each pilot weld coupon. Apply couplant and scan the weld zone with the A-scan probe. Record the signal amplitude, identify the nugget boundary, and measure the nugget diameter from the scan image.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply ultrasonic couplant to the electrode face side of each pilot weld coupon and scan the weld zone using an A scan ultrasonic probe. Record the reflected signal amplitude and the back wall echo attenuation. Identify the nugget boundary and measure the nugget diameter from the scan image. Compare against the minimum nugget diameter in the weld quality specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Ultrasonic scans completed on all five coupons. Nugget boundaries are clearly defined and diameters measured from the images.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply ultrasonic couplant to the electrode face side of each pilot weld coupon and scan the weld zone using an A scan ultrasonic probe. Record the reflected signal amplitude and the back wall echo attenuation. Identify the nugget boundary and measure the nugget diameter from the scan image. Compare against the minimum nugget diameter in the weld quality specification.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Does the weld nugget diameter meet the minimum requirement for the material thickness?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld nugget diameter meets minimum for material thickness?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all five nuggets are measuring above the minimum. The smallest is five point eight millimeters against a five point five minimum.

ground_truth.node_text: Weld nugget diameter meets minimum for material thickness?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Does the peel test show button pull failure mode with no interfacial fracture?

ground_truth.node_text: Peel test shows button pull failure mode, no interfacial fracture?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all specimens show full button pull. No interfacial fractures observed. The failure mode is acceptable.

ground_truth.node_text: Peel test shows button pull failure mode, no interfacial fracture?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Was the weld controller backup completed successfully?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld controller backup completed successfully?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the backup transfer failed. I'm getting a network connection error on the controller display.

ground_truth.node_text: Weld controller backup completed successfully?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Verify the marking controller is connected to the factory network. Navigate to the archive menu, check that the last record was written successfully, and confirm the archive path and file permissions are correctly configured.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Verify the marking controller is connected to the factory network. 2. Navigate to the archive menu and check that the last record was written successfully. 3. Confirm the archive path and file permissions are correctly configured.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Network connection verified and the archive path is now correct. Permissions have been reset.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Verify the marking controller is connected to the factory network. 2. Navigate to the archive menu and check that the last record was written successfully. 3. Confirm the archive path and file permissions are correctly configured.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Measure the cooling water return temperature at steady state. Immerse a calibrated thermocouple in the return line closest to the electrode holder exit. Allow the machine to complete twenty welds at production rate and record the temperature.

ground_truth.node_text: Immerse a calibrated thermocouple probe in the cooling water return line at the point closest to the electrode holder exit. Allow the machine to complete 20 welds at production rate and record the return line temperature at steady state. Compare against the maximum allowable return temperature in the cooling system specification; excessive temperature indicates inadequate cooling flow or fouled heat exchanger plates.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Temperature monitoring complete after twenty welds. The return line is reading thirty-eight degrees Celsius at steady state.

ground_truth.node_text: Immerse a calibrated thermocouple probe in the cooling water return line at the point closest to the electrode holder exit. Allow the machine to complete 20 welds at production rate and record the return line temperature at steady state. Compare against the maximum allowable return temperature in the cooling system specification; excessive temperature indicates inadequate cooling flow or fouled heat exchanger plates.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the coolant return temperature within the rated range?

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant return temperature within rated range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, it's running hot. Thirty-eight degrees is above the maximum allowable return temperature for this system.

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant return temperature within rated range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Check the chiller setpoint and clean the condenser to restore proper cooling performance.

ground_truth.node_text: Check chiller setpoint and clean condenser

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm seeing refrigerant oil foaming in the sight glass, and there's a burnt smell coming from the compressor motor windings — neither the setpoint nor the condenser seem to be the issue here.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Chiller setpoint verified and condenser cleaned. The unit is now running at the correct temperature.

ground_truth.node_text: Check chiller setpoint and clean condenser

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Run twenty consecutive production welds at standard schedule settings. Log the weld current, force, and time for each weld from the controller data output. Inspect the final five weld spots visually for consistent button size and absence of surface expulsion.

ground_truth.node_text: Run 20 consecutive production welds at the standard schedule settings with the machine in normal production configuration. Log the weld current, weld force, and weld time for each weld from the controller weld data output. Inspect the final five weld spots visually for consistent button size and absence of surface expulsion before signing off the qualification record.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Production qualification run complete. All twenty welds logged and the final five spots show consistent quality with no expulsion.

ground_truth.node_text: Run 20 consecutive production welds at the standard schedule settings with the machine in normal production configuration. Log the weld current, weld force, and weld time for each weld from the controller weld data output. Inspect the final five weld spots visually for consistent button size and absence of surface expulsion before signing off the qualification record.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all production qualification welds within specification?

ground_truth.node_text: All production qualification welds within specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Hey, quick question - do we need to update the lockout/tagout log before we continue, or can I fill that out after we're done here?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all twenty welds meet specification. Current, force, and time are all within tolerance across the entire run.

ground_truth.node_text: All production qualification welds within specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log the electrode data, calibration results, and qualification record to complete the documentation.

ground_truth.node_text: Log electrode data, calibration results and qualification record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All data logged and the qualification record has been signed off in the system.

ground_truth.node_text: Log electrode data, calibration results and qualification record

turns.utterance: Resistance welding electrode diagnostic and qualification procedure is now complete. The machine is qualified for production operation.

turns.utterance: Understood, procedure complete and machine ready for production.
